## Constituencies and council areas

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Scottish_Westminster_constituencies_2005_to_2024&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Constituencies and council areas")]

The Fifth Review of the [Boundary Commission for Scotland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boundary_Commission_for_Scotland "Boundary Commission for Scotland") related the boundaries of new constituencies to those of [Scottish local government council areas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Council_areas_of_Scotland "Council areas of Scotland") and to local government wards. Apart from a few minor adjustments, the council area boundaries dated from 1996 and the ward boundaries dated from 1999. Some council areas were grouped to form larger areas and, within these larger areas, some constituencies straddle council area boundaries.

The same council area and ward boundaries were in use when the new constituencies were first used in 2005, but ward boundaries have changed since then. New wards were introduced for the [2007 Scottish local government elections](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2007_Scottish_local_government_elections "2007 Scottish local government elections").

As a result of the Fifth Periodical Review of the [Boundary Commission for Scotland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boundary_Commission_for_Scotland "Boundary Commission for Scotland"), [Scotland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scotland "Scotland") was covered by 59 [constituencies](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Kingdom_constituencies "United Kingdom constituencies") of the [House of Commons](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/House_of_Commons_of_the_United_Kingdom "House of Commons of the United Kingdom") of the [United Kingdom](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/United_Kingdom "United Kingdom")[Parliament](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Parliament_of_the_United_Kingdom "Parliament of the United Kingdom"): 19 [burgh constituencies](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Borough_constituency "Borough constituency") and 40 [county constituencies](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/County_constituencies "County constituencies"). These constituencies were used from the [2005](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2005_United_Kingdom_general_election_in_Scotland "2005 United Kingdom general election in Scotland") to the [2019 general elections](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2019_United_Kingdom_general_election_in_Scotland "2019 United Kingdom general election in Scotland"), and were replaced by new constituencies at the [2024](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_United_Kingdom_general_election_in_Scotland "2024 United Kingdom general election in Scotland") election.

## Constituencies and council areas

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Scottish_Westminster_constituencies_2005_to_2024&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Constituencies and council areas")]

The Fifth Review of the [Boundary Commission for Scotland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boundary_Commission_for_Scotland "Boundary Commission for Scotland") related the boundaries of new constituencies to those of [Scottish local government council areas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Council_areas_of_Scotland "Council areas of Scotland") and to local government wards. Apart from a few minor adjustments, the council area boundaries dated from 1996 and the ward boundaries dated from 1999. Some council areas were grouped to form larger areas and, within these larger areas, some constituencies straddle council area boundaries.

The same council area and ward boundaries were in use when the new constituencies were first used in 2005, but ward boundaries have changed since then. New wards were introduced for the [2007 Scottish local government elections](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2007_Scottish_local_government_elections "2007 Scottish local government elections").
